newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Woolworths unit loses to Davids.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Woolworths unit loses to Davids.

text.p: A group of 34 Canberra and New South Wales (NSW) independent supermarkets have withdrawn from supply arrangements with Woolworths Ltd's unit Australian Independent Wholesalers (AIW), Retail Logistics Ltd said on Monday.

Peter Bunn, chairman of the recently formed independent marketing support company, Retail Logistics, said the move follows dissatisfaction with the AIW relationship since Woolworths acquired the wholesaler in May last year.
Bunn said the group of supermarkets will now be supplied by rival food wholesaler, Davids Ltd.
At 1.40 p.m. (0240 GMT), Woolworths shares were steady at A$3.36, while Davids shares were seven cents lower at A$1.37.
